abhts_22.17.literal: Now (atha) in-couple (yāmale): of-power (śakter) mark (lakṣaṇam) this (etat) — like-it (tadvad) nondifference (abhedas) then (tato) without-regard (anapekṣya) age-and-the-rest (vayaḥ jātyādīṃś ca) non-attachment (asaṅgāt); of-other-than-world-couple-born (loketarayugalajaṃ hi) identity (tādātmyam)

abhts_22.21.literal: By-each-own-enjoyment-non-enjoyment-variety (nijanijabhogābhogapravikāsa- mayasvarūpaparimarśe); gradually (kramaśaḥ) subcircle-goddesses (anucakradevyaḥ) consciousness-circle (saṃviccakraṃ hi) middle (madhyamaṃ) go (yānti)

abhts_22.23+tail.literal: Thus (itthaṃ) couple (yāmalam etad) melted-difference (galitabhidāsaṃkata) ... (22.24–22.33 per T1: lotus-petals, khecarī-mudrā, nāda-bhairava, mantra-vīrya, etc.) [Three-cornered lotus petals, sixteenth-petal root, nāla; middle throb, moon-sun clash, instant creation; khecarī-mudrā entry (22.34–22.37). Throb at throat, ear-eye-mouth-nose channels, eight nāda-bhairavas; mantra-vīrya from it; karma in karma, knower gains freedom-in-life; knowledge- vessel body, empty/full abode, single-staff fire-wind, trident equalized, doubtless, no-conduct, self not-I, body-gods as bliss-shock... (22.38–22.45). Further verses on grahītā, khecarī-siddhi etc. (22.46–22.54). Full close pass queued.]
